title: Farm Flapper
shortDescription: Flap, shoot eggs at farm pests, ride mounts, climb the board.
fullDescription:
Defend the farm in this one-thumb arcade flap game.

Tap to flap. Shoot eggs at mice, crows, cats, foxes, and bulls. Grab coins and clovers. Ride farm mounts. Land eggs in the farmer's basket to multiply your score.

• Fast portrait arcade — learn in seconds
• Combos, mounts, clovers, extra lives
• Animated score tally
• Beat your best and share the run

From Apex Arcade Studio.
